title: Under Siege (1992) is legitimately one of Tommy Lee Jones best roles.

commenti.body:
Well I don't really agree with the title just because TLJ has had so many brilliant roles, but he is quite good in it. Far better than when he delivered a similar manic but extremely irritating performance in Batman Forever. 

Always hated how he just gets BTFO so easily at the end though. As you say, Seagal's biggest weakness as an action star was (ironically) his invulnerability. He could never look weak or lose a fight. Fine for one or two films but not every single time. Even the Terminator got his ass kicked ffs. Hard to craft a compelling action film when your main character is not an underdog.

>As Die Hard clones go though, Under Siege is one of the better examples and is entertaining throughout.

I agree with this - although it was the movie that prevented us from having an actual Die Hard on a boat. 

It's also Seagal best movie, where despite his refusal to show anything resembling weakness, the story makes him face enough hurdles to keep it interesting and entertaining enough. 

TLJ is great in it too and I agree it should be up there with his best roles. He is so good as a villain. If you compared Under Siege with its sequel you can clearly see that one of Under Siege 2 weaknesses is definitely the villain.
